  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `organizationId` int NOT NULL,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `role` enum('owner','admin','marketer','viewer') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'viewer',
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
